name: Aesirbard
storyline:
He died in a tavern brawl. A tankard to the head; a worthless end for a soul worth saving.

At the gates of Hel, Eir of the Aesir was waiting. She did not offer rest, she offered a choice: return and serve the Aesir, or continue through the gates.

Eir's ward was raised to shield Kerrivik from the agents of Hel. Now it holds the village captive. The ferry does not come, the mill offers no flour, and no one can say why the ley turned against them.
summary: Aesirbard is a fantasy Norse-inspired Metroidvania of hard steel and old magic. Sent back from the gates of Hel, fight the corrupted and the restless dead, and rewire the hidden power that underpins the world to free a village trapped by its own ward.
